DIARY CONVERTER

Bring an old diary in. One entry a day.

Open a diary kept as plain text (your own, or one from Project Gutenberg) and get .jot files with a dated entry for each day. It all happens in this browser: nothing is uploaded.

The diary

Or drop a file anywhere on this page. Plain text, UTF-8 (on Project Gutenberg: Plain Text UTF-8).

Your browser asks that site for the file directly. Many sites (Project Gutenberg among them) don't allow that: download the file and open it instead.

Options

Only needed if the diary never says the year, for example 1888.
Title, author, source and file name

Left empty, they come from a Project Gutenberg header, or from the title.
